page.overview:
What is Mega Ampharos?

Ampharos appears to be a tall, yellow sheep Pokémon who has black stripes on its ears, long neck, and tail. It has a red orb on its forehead and at the end of its tail that has the ability to glow in dark places. Ampharos has a fat white belly, the coloring of which ends at the base of its tail.

As a result of its evolution from Flaaffy, Ampharos has lost all of its wool.

Mega Ampharos has a more majestic look to it due to the energy from Mega Evolution stimulating its long-sleeping dragon's blood. The belly has sharp edges, its ears are also slightly longer and rounder in shape, the tip of its feet now black, and its tail is completely fluffy and containing several red orbs.

Ampharos is a gentle Pokémon that spends most of its time grazing in flocks of other Ampharos and its pre-evolutions, Mareep and Flaaffy. Because its tail glows brightly, in times of emergency it uses its tail as a beacon in the place of a lighthouse. The brighter the light, the healthier the individual. On the other hand. flickering, dimly glowing lights are signals of sickness or exhaustion. In the wild, these Pokémon usually keep their tails unlit to avoid detection from enemies. Lighthouses using Ampharos are legally required to have at least 3 of them at any given time to prevent any of them from being fatigued.
